core_meaning.primary_meaning: Rahima is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Merciful, compassionate”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Rahima corresponds to the Arabic form رَحِيمَة (Arabic root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m); رَحِيمَة (Raḥīma)). Its core sense is rahima; merciful, compassionate (feminine). Rahima is Arabic رَحِيمَة (Raḥīma) 'merciful, compassionate' (feminine), from the root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m). The source gloss 'Merciful, Compassionate' is consistent.
